description.p: CoordenacaoOP helps school pedagogical coordinators organize classes, import grades and student data, run class councils and produce the official documents that come out of them. It is built around the data exported by the São Paulo state education network (SED), and its interface is in Brazilian Portuguese.

O CoordenacaoOP ajuda a coordenação pedagógica a organizar turmas, importar notas e dados de alunos, conduzir conselhos de classe e gerar os documentos oficiais que saem deles. Foi feito em torno dos dados exportados pela Secretaria Escolar Digital (SED) de São Paulo.

ul.li: Class and student management, with CSV and grade-sheet (mapão) import
Gestão de turmas e alunos, com importação de CSV e de mapões
Class council with per-student referrals, grade adjustments and a meeting mode
Conselho de classe com encaminhamentos por aluno, ajustes de nota e modo reunião
Council minutes and teacher reports generated as .docx
Ata do conselho e relatório para professores em .docx
Kanban board and calendar with deadline alerts inside the app
Quadro Kanban e calendário com avisos de prazo dentro do app
Optional sync between coordinators through a shared folder
Sincronização opcional entre coordenadores por uma pasta compartilhada

screenshot.caption: Kanban board with deadline alerts
Quadro Kanban com avisos de prazo

ul.li: Printable diagnostic report for each class, and a diagnostic tab for each student
Describe a report in plain words and the AI assistant builds it
Deadline alerts from the Kanban board now show up in an alert center inside the app
New imports for weekly attendance and SARESP results
